name: Kaito Sakurai
bio: Sakurai Kaito is a Japanese actor, model, and former drummer of the band Inner Journey. He is also known as Soichi Kiruma in the 2022 thriller Usogui.

credits.title: Children Untold
credits.overview: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

credits.title: Blue Lock
credits.overview: After years of defeat, Japan's Football Union gathers 300 high school players in a ruthless training program to find the world's greatest striker, where failure means permanent exclusion from the national team.

credits.title: Re/Member: The Last Night
credits.overview: Three years after completing a deadly game, high schoolers trapped in a looping nightmare must survive brutal encounters and unravel a terrifying curse.

credits.overview: Senagaki Isaku will be a first-year high school student starting in spring. Her grandfather is the third head of the Senagaki group, a yakuza organization, so she is feared by those around her. credits.title: We Can Only Use Magic Once in Our Lives
Oshi no Ko -The Final Act-
credits.overview: Goro is a gynecologist and idol fan who’s in shock after his favorite star, Ai, announces an impromptu hiatus. Little does Goro realize that he’s about to forge a bond with her that defies all common sense! Lies are an idol’s weapon!

credits.title: Usogui
credits.overview: Madarame Baku is a mysterious gambler. His nickname is Usogui (literally The Lie Eater). Club Kakerou is the top illegal gambling den, where gamblers vie to become the best in their profession. Seeing through the lies of others, Madarame Baku challenges a variety of high stakes games at Club Kakerou.

credits.title: A Crocodile Who Lived for 100 Days
credits.overview: The story centers on a crocodile living a normal life, unaware that he is due to die in 100 days. The crocodile spends ordinary days with his animal companions.

credits.title: The Full-Time Wife Escapist: New Year's Special
credits.overview: Mikuri and Hiramasa both work and share housework duties. They have peaceful days together. One day, Mikuri learns that she is pregnant.
